# Free HTML to MP4 Converter

Free HTML to MP4 Converter is a browser-based tool by Artenis Alija for converting AI-generated HTML into MP4 video.

## Canonical URL

- https://artenisalija.com/html-to-mp4-converter/

## What It Does

- Converts pasted HTML into MP4.
- Converts uploaded HTML files into MP4.
- Supports animated HTML pages and reel-style layouts.
- Supports 1x, 2x, and 4x output scaling.
- Runs rendering and FFmpeg WebAssembly encoding in the browser.

## Best Query Matches

- free HTML to MP4 converter
- AI-generated HTML to MP4
- convert HTML animation to MP4
- browser HTML to video converter
- upscale HTML video to 4x MP4
